entities.name: Niharo
entities.description: A boy who developed fire abilities from a secret liquid experiment after his parents were killed.
entities.quote: Niharo is a character who's father used to serve govt.but in that era science seemed like blackmagic.

timeline_events.title: Death of Niharo's Parents
timeline_events.description: Niharo's mother and father were killed by an invading crowd inside their home.
timeline_events.quote: a bullet,direct in the head of his father and next the sword penitrate his mother.

timeline_events.title: Niharo's Awakening and Slaughter
timeline_events.description: While tied to a burning cross, Niharo unlocked his fire powers and destroyed the townspeople.
timeline_events.quote: when he got the fire heat ,that liquid worked and it became his ability.
